'''Steel leggings''' are the [[Steel equipment|steel]] [[Armor#Leggings|leggings]], made by smithing [[iron leggings]] with [[steel alloy]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template. Enchantments on the iron item carry over; where both items have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
They give 5 armor, 1 armor toughness and 10% knockback resistance, with 1000 durability. The Blast Protection III is an intrinsic: it is stored on the item and applied when the item enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

Steel armor has 1000 durability per piece, armor toughness 1 and knockback resistance, and each piece carries [[Blast Protection]]. The full set gives 16 armor, 4 toughness, 50% knockback resistance and Blast Protection totalling 11 levels. The 1.10 release notes advise against wearing it in the [[Abbey]]: "Blast resistance makes the dungeon boring."

=== Repairing ===
They can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so they can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

They keep the iron item ID, so a [[blast furnace]] melts them back into a single iron ingot and the steel alloy is lost.

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows knockback resistance 1 (real value 0.1).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_leggings.json}}</ref>
